headline: Executive Assistant

experience.title: Executive Assistant to the President
bullets: Run the president's calendar across three sites and two time zones for overseas buyers, and prepare a briefing folder for each meeting.
Screen and answer routine email, drafting replies for approval, so the president sees only what needs a decision.
Keep board and contract files in order in Google Drive, with access limited by role.
Organise the annual planters' assembly for 400 guests, from invitations to the minutes.

experience.title: Administrative Officer
experience.employer: Western Panay Rural Electric Service Co.
bullets: Managed the general manager's schedule, visitors and correspondence records.
Set up a document tracking sheet for incoming letters and their replies.

summary: Executive assistant with five years supporting company presidents and general managers in Antique. I manage complex calendars, inboxes and travel, prepare meeting papers and minutes, and keep sensitive documents organised and confidential. Equally comfortable in Microsoft Office and Google Workspace.

education.credential: Bachelor of Arts in English Language Studies
